topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: Can you even believe it? The place where we used to go every single Friday night, where they knew our orders before we even stepped in, it's going to be just... gone. I keep thinking about the waitress who always had that extra smile for us, and the time we got stuck there during that crazy storm. It's like a piece of us is closing down too, you know? I don’t want to think about the last time we’ll be there, savoring those dishes that hit just right. It’s not just a restaurant, it’s a memory box. We have to do something, anything. Let’s go there again soon, make one more memory. Just to hold on to it a little longer.
